findings.issue: Path is checked then opened normally; symlink swap can follow a root-external file. No regular-file/single-link check; FIFO can block before integrity validation.
findings.minimal_fix: Descriptor based no-follow directory walk and O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK leaf open; fstat regular single-link, bounded offset/length, version and namespace checks, existing SHA and schema validation unchanged.

findings.issue: A files/default command is accepted under a packed-only inventory registration, so declared record layout is not actually enforced in both directions.
findings.minimal_fix: Require actual parsed layout to match registration/strategy in both branches; retain legal legacy files registrations with no strategy.
